title: Pip & the BIG berry
story: Pip discovers a giant strawberry, gives it a gentle boop, and hops with delight.

title: Pip and the shy bubble
story: 0-4s: A bubble drifts behind Pip. 4-8s: He turns and it hides behind a leaf. 8-13s: Pip sits quietly and holds out a paw. 13-17s: The bubble lands gently, reflecting a tiny rainbow. 17-20s: Pip waves as it floats safely away.

title: Pip wakes a sunflower
story: 0-4s: Pip finds a drooping sunflower. 4-8s: He notices a little watering can. 8-13s: He tips a few sparkling drops onto the soil. 13-17s: The sunflower slowly lifts its head. 17-20s: Pip and the flower lean toward the sunshine together.

title: Pip meets his puddle friend
story: 0-4s: Pip spots a tiny puddle after rain. 4-8s: His reflection surprises him. 8-13s: He tilts left and right; his reflection follows. 13-17s: One gentle paw tap makes round ripples. 17-20s: The water settles and Pip smiles at his new friend.

title: Pip and the lost little light
story: 0-4s: At dusk, a softly glowing firefly circles Pip. 4-8s: Pip notices other lights beyond a leaf arch. 8-13s: He gently lifts the drooping leaf with his nose. 13-17s: The firefly rejoins its friends. 17-20s: Their steady warm glow lights Pip's happy face. No strobing.
